title: Every rational greater than 3/4 is the scl of a word in F_2, and this is sharp
body:
## The conjecture

Every rational greater than 3/4 is attained as scl of a word in F_2 -- a
strengthening of the expectation that every rational at least 1 is attained -- and
the threshold 3/4 is sharp.

## What supports it

Of the rationals p/q in (3/4, 1) with q at most 30, exactly two are missing from
the exhaustive sweep to length 20, namely 22/29 and 24/29. The first of these is
3/4 + 1/116, the m = 29 member of the family approaching 3/4 from above, so it
should appear at greater length.

Sharpness comes from the other side: below 3/4 the largest missing rational with
denominator at most Q climbs towards 3/4 as Q grows -- 7/11, 12/17, 20/27, 35/47
for Q = 12, 20, 30, 50 -- so no threshold smaller than 3/4 is possible.

The numbers here come from a computation carried out in an AI agent session in
August 2026 using `scallop`, in its rigorous exact-rational mode, and spot-checked
against two independent algorithms. **No person has checked it.** Treat it as
computational evidence and not as established fact.
